items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: Paul Cohen, he was the lead trumpet in Count Basie at the time, so when he was in New York and they weren’t on tour he’d just play gigs around New York and I mean it was amazing.

ctx.x: That’s right. I remember that from the liner notes.

Yes. And when I played with Clark — with Lionel Hampton when I was, you know like 19, the band was Jimmy Cleveland, Julian Priester, Jerome Richardson came one time to be in Lionel Hampton’s big band at the Riverboat in the Empire State Building. And I was playing with Lionel Hampton. Paul Cohen, he was the lead trumpet in Count Basie at the time, so when he was in New York and they weren’t on tour he’d just play gigs around New York and I mean it was amazing. The whole thing was amazing, just that I could be in…
Yeah, we’ll do a part two. We should do it.
